description: A rocky mountain gorge with smoke and dust. In the foreground, several men in rough dark work clothes, one with a head cloth, kneel or crouch behind a low stone wall and fire long muskets, with a flash of fire among the rocks. On the right, a cavalry soldier in a dark coat, tall plumed helmet and light cross-belt charges on a brown horse, raising a curved sabre, with a second mounted soldier with a red-plumed helmet behind him. Era cues are flintlock-style long guns and Napoleonic-looking cavalry uniforms. There is a faint tiny mark in the bottom-right corner, not a readable word or number. No blood or nudity is visible, and the painting runs edge to edge with no frame.
